Statusline HUD

English | 简体中文

A multi-line terminal statusline and interactive /hud plugin for Antigravity CLI (agy).

> [!NOTE] > Targets **Antigravity CLI (`agy`)** on Linux, macOS, and WSL. Desktop app sessions and IDE extensions do not render custom TUI status lines. ![Statusline HUD preview](./assets/example.png) ## Quick Start Requires `agy`, `bash` 3.2+, `jq` 1.6+, and optional `git`. 1. **Install the plugin** ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/linbo0518/antigravity-hud ``` 2. **Enable and customize** Launch `agy` and run **`/hud`**—it checks your setup, previews the bar, and walks you through enabling and customizing. Or activate directly with: ```text /statusline ~/.gemini/config/plugins/statusline-hud/scripts/statusline.sh ``` Re-run `agy plugin install ...` anytime to upgrade; your preferences are preserved automatically. ## Using `/hud` Everything is handled through `/hud` or plain natural language inside `agy`—no config files to memorize: - `/hud` — check setup, preview the layout, and toggle modules - `/hud setup` / `/hud uninstall` — guide enabling the statusline or safely uninstall - `/hud hide title` / `/hud show title` — hide or show any module (changes take effect immediately) - `/hud hide cost in split panes` — override modules only for narrow panes (`<100` cols) - `/hud check` — diagnose setup, config, or display issues - `/hud reset` — restore all defaults ## Symbols - **Git**: `[...]` status flags (`=` conflicted, `+` staged, `!` modified, `✘` deleted, `»` renamed, `?` untracked, `$` stashed, `↑N`/`↓N` ahead/behind) and `(+N −M)` tracked diff lines; narrow panes show `*` when dirty. - **Quota**: used % (green `<60%`, yellow `60–89%`, red `>=90%`) + reset time; count-only buckets show ` left`. - **Tokens**: `token (↑ ↓)` across the session. ## Uninstall Revert the statusline **before** removing the plugin: 1. In `agy`, run `/statusline delete`. 2. In your shell, run: ```bash agy plugin uninstall statusline-hud rm -rf "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/statusline-hud" "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/statusline-hud" # optional ```
Advanced: manual config.json, standalone install & development ### Manual `config.json` Stored at `${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/statusline-hud/config.json` (hot-reloads automatically): | Row | Switches (left to right) | | --- | --- | | 1 | `showMode`, `showModel`, `showContext`, `showPath`, `showGit` | | 2 | `showGeminiQuota`, `show3pQuota` | | 3 | `showArtifacts`, `showSubagents`, `showTasks`, `showSandbox`, `showTokens`, `showCache`, `showDuration`, `showCost`, `showTitle` | Core status always starts row 1. All switches are booleans defaulting to `true`; enabled count and state items (`context`, `artifacts`, `subagents`, `tasks`, `sandbox`, `tokens`, `duration`) show `0`, `0.0%`, `0m`, or `OFF` even when omitted by the CLI, while items with no value (such as an untitled session, non-Git path, or unreported quota/cache/cost) and empty rows are omitted. Below 100 columns, `narrow` overrides apply (missing keys inherit) and compact text forms are used; long rows may wrap. ```json { "showTitle": false, "showCost": false, "narrow": { "showCost": true } } ``` ### Standalone single-script install (without `/hud`) ```bash cp scripts/statusline.sh ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/statusline.sh chmod +x ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/statusline.sh ``` Then run `/statusline ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/statusline.sh` inside `agy`. ### Development & validation ```bash ./tests/test.sh agy plugin validate --strict . ```
## Acknowledgments - **[claude-hud](https://github.com/jarrodwatts/claude-hud)** by Jarrod Watts (MIT License) — multi-line HUD hierarchy and `/hud` workflow inspiration. - **[Google Antigravity CLI `statusline` example](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/tree/main/examples/statusline)** — 16-color palette and status payload reference. ## License [MIT](./LICENSE)
zh:
Statusline HUD

English | 简体中文

面向 Antigravity CLI (agy) 的多行终端状态栏与交互式 /hud 配置插件。

> [!NOTE] > 仅适用于 **Antigravity CLI (`agy`)**（Linux / macOS / WSL）；桌面端与 IDE 扩展不渲染自定义 TUI 状态栏。 ![Statusline HUD 效果预览](./assets/example.png) ## 快速开始 依赖：`agy`、`bash` 3.2+、`jq` 1.6+，以及可选的 `git`。 1. **安装插件** ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/linbo0518/antigravity-hud ``` 2. **启用与定制** 打开 `agy` 并输入 **`/hud`**，自动完成环境检查、效果预览与启用引导；或直接执行： ```text /statusline ~/.gemini/config/plugins/statusline-hud/scripts/statusline.sh ``` 随时重新运行 `agy plugin install ...` 即可升级，个人偏好会自动保留。 ## 使用 `/hud` 全部配置与维护都可以直接通过 `/hud` 或中英文自然语言完成，无需记忆配置文件格式： - `/hud` — 检查状态、预览当前状态栏并按需开关模块 - `/hud setup` / `/hud uninstall` — 引导启用状态栏或安全卸载 - `/hud hide title` / `/hud show title` — 隐藏或显示任意模块（修改立即热生效） - `/hud hide cost in split panes` — 仅在窄屏（`<100` 列）单独覆盖显示项 - `/hud check` — 排查依赖、配置或显示异常 - `/hud reset` — 恢复默认配置 ## 符号说明 - **Git**：`[...]` 仓库状态（`=` 冲突、`+` 已暂存、`!` 未暂存修改、`✘` 删除、`»` 重命名、`?` 未跟踪、`$` stash、`↑N`/`↓N` 领先/落后提交）与 `(+N −M)` 已跟踪增删行数；窄屏有改动时收敛为 `*`。 - **配额**：已用百分比（绿 `<60%`、黄 `60–89%`、红 `>=90%`）+ 距重置时间；仅返回剩余数量时显示 ` left`。 - **Token**：`token <总量> (<输入>↑ <输出>↓)`，按整场会话累计。 ## 卸载 卸载插件前请**先恢复默认状态栏**： 1. 在 `agy` 中执行 `/statusline delete`。 2. 在终端执行： ```bash agy plugin uninstall statusline-hud rm -rf "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/statusline-hud" "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/statusline-hud" # 可选 ```
进阶：手动编辑 config.json、单脚本安装与开发验证 ### 手动编辑 `config.json` 配置位于 `${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/statusline-hud/config.json`，修改后下次刷新自动生效： | 行 | 开关（从左到右） | | --- | --- | | 1 | `showMode`, `showModel`, `showContext`, `showPath`, `showGit` | | 2 | `showGeminiQuota`, `show3pQuota` | | 3 | `showArtifacts`, `showSubagents`, `showTasks`, `showSandbox`, `showTokens`, `showCache`, `showDuration`, `showCost`, `showTitle` | 核心状态始终在第一行开头。所有开关均为布尔值且默认全部开启；计数与状态项（上下文、产物、子代理、任务、沙箱、Token、时长）在 CLI 省略时按 `0`、`0.0%`、`0m` 或 `OFF` 照常显示，确实无值的项（如未生成标题、非 Git 目录、未上报的配额/缓存/费用）与空行自动省略。低于 100 列时生效 `narrow` 覆盖（未写则继承）并使用短写形式，内容过多时终端可能折行。 ```json { "showTitle": false, "showCost": false, "narrow": { "showCost": true } } ``` ### 手动单脚本安装（不含 `/hud`） ```bash cp scripts/statusline.sh ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/statusline.sh chmod +x ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/statusline.sh ``` 随后在 `agy` 中执行 `/statusline ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/statusline.sh`。 ### 开发与校验 ```bash ./tests/test.sh agy plugin validate --strict . ```
## 致谢 - **[claude-hud](https://github.com/jarrodwatts/claude-hud)**（by Jarrod Watts，MIT License）— 多行 HUD 层次与 `/hud` 交互思路启发。 - **[Google Antigravity CLI 官方 `statusline` 示例](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/tree/main/examples/statusline)** — 16 色基调与状态协议参考。 ## License [MIT](./LICENSE)
